# platform.AdminImpersonationSession

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A support access session for staff: who acted as whom, in which organization, why, and whether it is still open.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.AdminImpersonationSession` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `platform.user.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the session started (UTC). |  |
| `endedAt` | yes | `none` | When staff ended the session early (UTC); null while open. |  |
| `expiresAt` | yes | `none` | Hard end of the session (UTC), at most 60 minutes after start. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Impersonation session id (token claim `imp`). |  |
| `reason` | yes | `personal` | Why support needs the access; audited. |  |
| `staffUid` | yes | `personal` | Staff member acting as the user. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | `active`, `ended` or `expired`, at the time of the answer. |  |
| `targetUid` | yes | `personal` | User being impersonated. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Only organization the session may read. |  |

_None._
